1.summary: A negative promo percent now means no discount instead of an error. To get there the change drops the whole range check, so a percent above 100 now gives a total below zero.

sections.title: What changes
sections.text: `applyDiscount()` uses `Math.max(0, percent)` and no longer throws. -5% gives no discount. 150% off a 200-cent cart now totals -100 cents.

sections.title: Why
sections.text: REQ-21: operations type -5 to mean no promotion, and checkout showed an error page.

sections.title: What it reaches
sections.text: `checkoutTotal()` in Checkout and `importOrder()` in Order Import. Both call `applyDiscount()`. Neither is in the diff.

sections.title: What is tested
sections.text: Checkout: -5%, and 0, 10 and 100% keep their totals. 150% is only checked not to throw. Order Import: one test at -5%.

sections.title: What stays the same
sections.text: Percents from 0 to 100 give the same totals. Percents above 100 do not: they used to be rejected.
